question: In any tennis game, any game starts at 0 - 0 and the zero point in tennis is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**love**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In any tennis game, any game starts at 0 - 0 and the zero point in tennis is called **love**.
 
• The term "love" in tennis is used to describe a score of zero. For example, if a player has not scored any points in a game, their score is said to be "love".
 
• The origin of the term "love" is unclear, but it is widely used in tennis scoring.
 
• Understanding tennis scoring is essential for both players and spectators to follow the progress of the game.
